review_candidates.title: IT Systems Network Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The City of Tolleson is seeking a skilled Information Technology Systems Network Administrator to support and secure the Citys technology infrastructure. The Systems Network Administrator role emphasizes Cisco networking and enterprise firewall administration, requiring independent configuration, management, and troubleshooting of complex technology environments. Responsibilities include administeringCisco networks and firewalls, servers, storage, Hyper-V/VMware virtualization, INTRA technologie
eligibility_evidence: The position must be able to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds to waist height when installing, replacing, or relocating network, server, storage, and related technology equipment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Administration, Cybersecurity, or a related field, and at least five years of progressively responsible experience supporting enterprise networks, firewalls, servers, storage, virtualization, and Microsoft cloud technologies. Evaluating technical and business requirements and recommending secure, reliable, and cost-effective solutions. Employment Requirements Valid Arizona drivers license required. Physical Requirements/Working Conditions Work is performed primarily in an office, server-room, data-center, and technology-equipment environment.
